title: Resolve dynamic HDR x265 artifact paths
summary: Adds Dynamic HDR x265 artifact-path resolution that converts successful extraction outputs into relative, colon-free paths for x265 parameters and fails closed for missing artifacts, rooted paths, cross-drive/colon-bearing paths, or missing base directories.
reason: Dynamic HDR extraction outputs are scratch paths, while x265 parameter parsing splits on colons and expects safe relative artifact paths. The encode hook needs a tested path gate before it can safely inject RPU or HDR10+ metadata artifacts.
behavior_before: Dynamic HDR extraction could produce RPU and HDR10+ artifacts, and encode flag builders accepted relative colon-free artifact paths, but there was no helper that converted extraction outputs into x265-safe paths or failed closed when that was impossible.
behavior_after: Resolve-DynamicHdrX265ArtifactPaths returns dynamic_hdr_x265_artifact_paths.v1 with safe relative artifact paths, carried target profile/frame-count evidence, and registered error codes for missing extraction results, missing base directories, unrepresentable paths, or missing artifacts. Add-DynamicHdrX265ParameterPairs now also rejects rooted paths directly.
tests_added: Extended ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-DynamicHdrToolingChecks.ps1 with x265 artifact path resolution success, missing-artifact, and cross-drive/unrepresentable path cases.
Extended ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-EncodeFlagPolicyChecks.ps1 with rooted Dynamic HDR artifact path rejection.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet plus Resolve-DynamicHdrX265ArtifactPaths, ConvertTo-DynamicHdrX265RelativePath, rooted-path x265 guard tightening, added outcome codes, tests, docs, and generated summaries. Earlier Dynamic HDR decision/extraction slices remain separate.

It does not call Export-DynamicHdrMetadata, does not invoke ffmpeg with preservation artifacts, does not change Do-Encode routing, and does not publish, drain, move, delete, or mutate media.
